<code class="nowrap">{{#switch:{{{2|pair}}}
 |c|close  = <!--nothing-->
 |s|single
 |o|open
 |p|pair   = &lt;{{{1|tag}}}{{#if:{{{params|}}}|&#32;{{{params}}}}}
}}{{#switch:{{{2|pair}}}
 |c|close  = {{{content|}}}
 |s|single = &#32;&#47;&gt;
 |o|open   = &gt;{{{content|}}}
 |p|pair   = {{#ifeq:{{{1|tag}}}|!--||&gt;}}{{{content|...}}}
}}{{#switch:{{{2|pair}}}
 |s|single
 |o|open   = <!--nothing-->
 |c|close
 |p|pair   = {{#ifeq:{{{1|tag}}}|!--|--&gt;|&lt;&#47;{{{1|tag}}}&gt;}}
}}</code><noinclude>
__NOTOC__
==Description==
This template provides a quick way to mention an [[wikipedia:XML|XML]]/[[wikipedia:HTML|HTML]]-style tag in a preformatted way. Mainly used in discussion/help pages.

==Usage==
 <nowiki>{{Tag|</nowiki>{{Var|name}}|{{Var|type}}<nowiki>|content=|params=}}</nowiki>

===Required parameters===
#{{Var|name}} The XML/HTML tag's name (e.g. <code>code</code>, <code>ref</code>, etc.) to display.
#{{Var|type}} To indicate which tag type to use (default <code>p</code>):
{| class="wikitable" style="width:700px"
! Value
! Output
|-
| style="text-align:center" | <code>p</code> || A matching pair of open/start and close/end tags (e.g. {{Tag|div|pair}}). To suppress the ellipsis ("...") between the tags, add an empty {{para|content}} parameter.
|-
| style="text-align:center" | <code>o</code> || An open/start tag (e.g. {{Tag|span|open}}).
|-
| style="text-align:center" | <code>c</code> || A close/end tag (e.g. {{Tag|span|close}}).
|-
| style="text-align:center" | <code>s</code> || A single tag (e.g. {{Tag|hr|single}}).
|}

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|content}} Text to place between open/start and close/end tags.
*{{Para|params}} Parameters to be included as part of an open/start tag.

==Examples==
{| class="wikitable"
! Code !! Result
|-
| <pre style="border:none; background:none">{{Tag|ref}}</pre> || {{Tag|ref}}
|-
| <pre style="border:none; background:none">{{Tag|ref|content=}}</pre> || {{Tag|ref|content=}}
|-
| <pre style="border:none; background:none">{{Tag|ref|content=hello}}</pre> || {{Tag|ref|content=hello}}
|-
| <pre style="border:none; background:none">{{Tag|font|content=foo}}</pre> || {{Tag|font|content=foo}}
|-
| <pre style="border:none; background:none">{{Tag|font|open}}</pre> || {{Tag|font|open}}
|-
| <pre style="border:none; background:none">{{Tag|font|open|content=hello}}</pre> || {{Tag|font|open|content=hello}}
|-
| <pre style="border:none; background:none">{{Tag|span|close|content=hello}}</pre> || {{Tag|span|close|content=hello}}
|-
| <pre style="border:none; background:none">{{Tag|span|pair|content=hello}}</pre> || {{Tag|span|pair|content=hello}}
|-
| <pre style="border:none; background:none">{{Tag|ref|open|params=group="note"}}</pre> || {{Tag|ref|open|params=group="note"}}
|-
| <pre style="border:none; background:none">{{Tag|references|single}}</pre> || {{Tag|references|single}}
|-
| <pre style="border:none; background:none">{{Tag|br|single}}</pre> || {{Tag|br|single}}
|-
| <pre style="border:none; background:none">{{Tag|!--|content=comment}}</pre> || {{Tag|!--|content=comment}}
|}
